name: mastergo-ui-fidelity
title_zh: 照着 MasterGo 还原前端
tagline_zh: 设计稿截图、MCP 数据都能读，自动恢复资源和精确几何。对比浏览器截图揪出像素差，把已确认的页面推进到真实路由。
tagline_en: Reads MasterGo MCP or snapshots, recovers assets and exact geometry, diffs browser shots, then advances approved.
desc_en: Reconstruct and polish production frontend pages from MasterGo designs. Use when reading MasterGo MCP data or `.mastergo/design` snapshots, recovering assets and exact geometry, implementing a page or section without copying broken D2C layout, comparing browser screenshots, fixing visual differences, or advancing an approved page into real routes, data, responsive layouts, and motion.
why_zh: 不拿 D2C 生成的残次品糊弄，而是从设计数据里重建干净结构。每一步都对照截图验证。
why_en: Refuses to ship broken D2C output; rebuilds clean structure from design data, verifies each step against screenshots before.
limit_zh: 只认 MasterGo 数据或 .mastergo/design 快照，其他设计源不读。产物到可运行前端页面为止。
limit_en: Only reads MasterGo MCP or .mastergo/design snapshots. Output ends at runnable frontend; no backend, auth, or cross-platform. Visual diff needs.
title_en: Rebuild frontend from MasterGo, skip broken D2C
